## Outcome

What should be true when this is done?

## Context

Why this matters. Include relevant PRD, roadmap, project state, Slack thread, document, or file links.

## Scope

What the agent is allowed to change.

## Out of Scope

What the agent must not touch.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Clear result 1
- [ ] Clear result 2
- [ ] Clear result 3

## Verification

How should the agent prove this works? Include commands, manual checks, screenshots, or review steps.

## Autonomy Level

A0 Ask First / A1 Plan + Draft / A2 Build Locally / A3 Build + PR / A4 Maintain

## Approval Needed

List anything Crystal must approve first: credentials, live deployment, paid services, Slack messages, database changes, external access, or production data.

## Final Report Required

The agent must report:

- what changed
- what passed
- what was not tested
- what needs Crystal's decision
